Shipped. Here's the final report:

---

**Milestones B–H complete. 265/265 tests. Committed to `codex/proof-mode-content-injection`.**

## What was built this session

**22 new deterministic workers** across 7 milestones:

| Milestone | Workers | Tests |
|---|---|---|
| B — Bootstrap/config | repo-bootstrap, config-scaffold | 6/6 |
| C — Architecture/content/build | arch-decider, sitemap-planner, page-copy, design-token, js-behavior, page-builder, shared-assets, assembly | 19/19 |
| D — Components/media (non-blocking) | component-selector, custom-component-builder, media-planner, media-generation | 12/12 |
| E — SEO/QA/proof | seo-pack, structural-qa, content-qa, browser-qa, proof-curator, gap-logger | 14/14 |
| F — Deploy | netlify-staging-deploy, prod-deploy-router, legacy-compat | 7/7 |
| G — Operator bridge | server-bridge.js + `POST /api/vnext-build` in server.js | 5/5 |
| H — Legacy audit | LEGACY-AUDIT.md, gate sequence for de-authorization | — |

**Key design decisions honored:**
- Provider-agnostic: all 22 workers registered as `deterministic` family — no Claude dependency in primary path
- Non-blocking: component and media workers never throw; builds complete green/yellow/red
- Explicit deploy opt-in: staging requires `deploy.staging_deploy: true`; prod requires that flag AND green/yellow QA proof
- Security: `execFileSync` with argument arrays throughout (no shell string interpolation)
- Legacy preserved: `server.js` legacy path untouched pending shadow-run parity proof (documented gate sequence in `LEGACY-AUDIT.md`)
